name: 小狮鹫（高山地的样子）
evolution: 小狮鹫 → 神圣狮鹫 Lv.32 → 皇家狮鹫 Lv.46
description: 只能勉强顶破头部的壳，剩余的蛋壳会陪伴小狮鹫度过幼年时期，能够抵御高山的严寒。皮肤表面覆盖嫩黄的绒毛，有保温发热的作用。
descriptionEn: It can barely break through the shell over its head; the rest of the eggshell stays with the young Xiaoshijiu through its infancy and can withstand the bitter cold of the high mountains. Its skin is covered with tender yellow down, which keeps it warm and generates heat.

skills.name: 疾风刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，若先于敌方攻击，改为3连击。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; 1 hit; if attacking before the enemy, changed to 3 hits.

skills.name: 飞羽
skills.descriptionEn: Swift; dispels 1 buff from the enemy.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%; counters attacks.

skills.name: 见招拆招
skills.description: 造成物伤，若上回合使用状态技能，本次技能威力+55。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if a status skill was used last turn, this use's skill power +55.

skills.name: 羽化加速
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+20，迅捷。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains +20 power to all skills; swift.

skills.name: 扇风
skills.description: 造成物伤，若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if attacking before the enemy, this use's skill power +50%.

skills.name: 闪击
skills.description: 造成物伤，速度比敌方越高，本次技能威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the higher your SPD is compared with the enemy's, the higher this use's skill power.

skills.name: 快速移动
skills.description: 自己获得速度+80，应对防御：改为速度+160。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains SPD +80; when countering a defense skill: changed to SPD +160.

skills.name: 羽刃
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：回合结束使敌方紧急脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when countering a status skill: forces the enemy to emergency-withdraw at the end of the turn.

skills.name: 龙卷风
skills.description: 造成物伤，迅捷，应对状态：本次技能威力变为1.5倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; swift; when countering a status skill: this use's skill power becomes 1.5x.
